claims.text: Apple's capital expenditures (payments for property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2024 (2024-06-30 to 2024-09-28) were about $2.908 billion. The figure is derived as full-year FY2024 capex of $9.447 billion minus the nine-month figure of $6.539 billion.
